title: Dark Witch Match!
description:
A Match-3 Showdown from The Legend of Dark Witch!
The familiar faces of the series clash in a brand-new puzzle battle. Easy to pick up, deep to master — a truly competitive puzzle game, Dark Witch Match!

■ Deep, Competitive Match-3 Battles
Match three or more blocks to clear them, chain combos, and pile the pressure onto your opponent. Simple rules hide a world of mind games and strategy.

■ Cross-Platform Versus (Steam ⇔ Nintendo Switch)
Steam and Nintendo Switch players battle on the same stage. No barriers — take on anyone, anytime.

■ Online & Local Versus
Test your skills against players worldwide online, or go head-to-head with friends in local matches.

■ Score Attack & Global Leaderboards
Chase high scores and climb the ranks. The more you play, the hotter the climb to the top.

■ Story Mode (8 Stages)
Take on a cast of quirky rivals across 8 stages, with light, comedic banter along the way.

■ A Beloved Cast Returns
Zizou, Klinsy, Al, Sola and more — series favorites all in one place.
description_short: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.
